admin.name: Admin Kost
admin.capabilities: Kendali penuh tambah, edit, hapus data penghuni dan foto KTP

user.name: RT / RW / Owner (View Only)

restrictions.watermark_overlay: HANYA DOKUMEN VERIFIKASI RT/RW - DILARANG TANGKAP LAYAR / SIMPAN

visual_enhancers.ios_card: bg-white rounded-3xl border border-stone-200/80 shadow-[0_4px_20px_-4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_-4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]
visual_enhancers.keypad_button: w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-stone-100 active:bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xl font-semibold text-stone-800 transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 shadow-xs border border-stone-200/50
visual_enhancers.segmented_control: bg-stone-200/60 p-1 rounded-2xl flex gap-1 border border-stone-200/40

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first priority (375px - 430px ideal iOS viewport), scale gracefully to tablet and desktop
responsive.layout: Single column fluid stack on mobile, grid layout on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3)
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px touch targets for all interactive buttons and keypad inputs
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root and sheet containers

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using JavaScript React components (.js files, not .tsx).
Implement PIN Login with exact PINs: Admin '060896', User '00100735'. Store session state in LocalStorage or React Context.
Data structure per resident: id, nomor_kamar (string, e.g. '101', 'A-02'), nama_penghuni (string), foto_ktp (base64 string or URL).
Ensure strict Protection for Role User (RT/RW/Owner): prevent context menu, disable image drag, user-select: none, floating security notice overlay on fullscreen viewer.
Include zoom/pan controls (+ / - / reset and touch scale) in the Fullscreen KTP viewer Modal.
Admin actions: Add resident modal/sheet with image file picker converting to Base64, Edit resident sheet, Delete confirm dialog.

Add test IDs (`data-testid`) on all primary elements (login pin buttons, logout button, room input, name input, upload button, submit button, search input, resident card, edit button, delete button, zoom controls).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide or Radix icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
